en: A vintage, blue-toned postcard showing a river scene with boats and houses along the shore. In the background, there is a prominent iron viaduct (bridge) with arched stone supports. Two people stand near the riverbank, and the setting suggests a serene, small-town atmosphere. The top of the postcard has printed text in Spanish that reads: '7 - REDONDELA. Pleamar y viaducto a Pontevedra.' The bottom left has a small label: 'Biblioteca de Galicia.'
